name: deja-vu
title: Deja-Vu
description: Search and resume sessions across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and 38 more coding agents.
author: vshulcz

commands.name: search-sessions
commands.title: Search Sessions
commands.description: Full-text search across every coding agent session on this Mac.

commands.name: recent-sessions
commands.title: Recent Sessions
commands.description: Browse the 100 most recent coding agent sessions across all harnesses.

preferences.name: dejaPath
preferences.title: deja Binary Path
preferences.description: Optional path to the deja binary if not in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, ~/.local/bin or ~/go/bin.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
